title: Console backend: experiment results query API (pagination, caching, query limits)
author: Chloe Martin
description: Adds the initial results query API used by the Console A/B Testing results dashboard. This builds on the aggregation/materialized-view work from ENG-2844 and provides stable, paginated queries for time series graphs and summary tables, with guardrails to prevent expensive/high-cardinality queries from impacting the control plane. The API is read-only and gated behind existing Console entitlements. What’s included: new REST endpoints for experiment results (time series + summary) keyed by experiment_id, variant_id; cursor-based pagination for tabular drilldowns (top routes / error codes / regions) and sampled request IDs; response caching for common dashboard queries (e.g., last 1h/6h/24h) with short TTL and explicit cache-bypass for debugging; query limits (max time range, max buckets, max group-by dims) enforced server-side with clear error messages; consistent handling of partial data and late-arriving telemetry (watermark + “data completeness” indicator); per-request query budget tracking + structured logs for slow queries. Endpoints (v1): GET /console/v1/ab/experiments/{experiment_id}/results/summary?window=1h|6h|24h; GET /console/v1/ab/experiments/{experiment_id}/results/timeseries?metric=latency_p95|ttft_p95|error_rate|cost_per_1k_tokens&window=...&bucket=1m|5m|1h; GET /console/v1/ab/experiments/{experiment_id}/results/table?table=errors|regions|routes&window=...&page_size=...&cursor=... Notes/constraints: max window=30d; max buckets=2,000; max group_by dims=2; page_size capped at 200; only allowlisted dimensions are queryable (experiment_id, variant_id, region, status_family, error_code, route_id). This avoids the cardinality issues we’ve been seeing in staging when users try to group by request_id/api_key/etc. Caching: in-process + Redis (Console API cluster) with key = {experiment_id, endpoint, window, bucket, metric, filters}; TTL defaults to 30s for windows <= 6h and 120s otherwise. Cache entries are tagged and can be invalidated for a single experiment when guardrail evaluator triggers a rollback. Authz: requires console:ab_testing:read and membership in the project/tenant owning the experiment; experiment_id is resolved -> project_id before running the query. Testing: unit tests for query builder + limit enforcement; integration tests with a seeded ClickHouse test container; load test in CI job validates p95 handler latency under 200ms for cached queries and under 1.5s for uncached 24h queries. Follow-ups (not in this PR): add export endpoint (CSV/JSONL) with async job (PM request); add variant-to-control significance flags once Sana’s stats plan is wired into the datasets; wire the “data completeness” indicator into the UI (DES-143).

review_conversation: Logan Wright: Can we ensure the group_by allowlist is enforced even when the UI sends unknown filters? I’m worried about accidental high-cardinality queries if the UI changes.

Chloe Martin (author): Yup — the query builder now rejects any dimension not in AbResultsDimensionsAllowlist with a 400 (AB_RESULTS_INVALID_DIM). Added unit tests covering unknown dims + attempted injection via query param casing.
Mei Lin: For pagination, what’s the stable ordering? We’ve had issues where tables reshuffle between pages as data arrives late.

Chloe Martin (author): Stable order is (primary_metric desc, secondary key = dimension value asc) with a watermark applied at query time. Cursor encodes (watermark_ts, last_metric_value, last_dimension). That keeps pages consistent within the same watermark. Also added a note in API docs about late-arriving data and recommended UI behavior (refresh resets cursor).
Allison Grant: Please emit handler latency + cache hit rate metrics tagged by endpoint and window. Also ensure we don’t tag by experiment_id (cardinality).

Chloe Martin (author): Added ab_results_query_duration_ms and ab_results_cache_hit_total tagged by endpoint/method/window/bucket only (no experiment_id). Confirmed with the existing metrics tag allowlist from PR-18519 changes.
Dylan Brooks: Query limits look good, but 30d window seems high for uncached. Can we clamp buckets harder or force larger bucket sizes for long windows?

Chloe Martin (author): Adjusted validation: if window > 7d, bucket must be >= 1h; if window > 24h, bucket must be >= 5m. Also added server-chosen default bucket when omitted, based on window, to avoid accidental 1m buckets on long ranges.
Jada Williams: Any concerns about precedence between guardrails/rollback and cached values? We don’t want the dashboard to show stale post-rollback results for too long.

Chloe Martin (author): TTLs are short (30–120s) and we added invalidateByExperimentId() which guardrail evaluator can call. Not wired yet, but the hook is in place and documented in TODO with ENG-2845.
release_notes: Internal: Adds Console API endpoints powering A/B experiment results dashboards (summary + time series + tables) with server-side query limits and caching.
